dedupe_keys.name: registre des transactions de garanties de capacite

description: Registre des transactions de garanties de capacité is a dataset listed in Open Data Réseaux Énergies (ODRÉ), a shared open data portal of the French energy network operators, published or maintained by RTE, GRTgaz, Teréga, Enedis, GRDF and other French network operators (ODRÉ). Les règles du mécanisme de capacité, dans leur version arrêtée le 29 novembre 2016, renforcent les dispositifs de transparence sur les échanges de garanties de capacité. Coverage: France. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Marchés. The portal shows 2026-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odre-open-data-portal.
